outcomes.statement: A group admin can acknowledge an alert from SCR-alerts, and the alert records who acknowledged it and when, so triage state is visible to the next admin instead of living in someone's memory.
outcomes.demo: On the alertas screen, acknowledge a row from the 'sin reconocer' tab; the row moves out of that tab, shows the acknowledging user and timestamp in the 'todas' tab, and the unacknowledged badge count drops.

uncertainties.statement: Whether acknowledgment needs a migration for column privileges, since alert_event is otherwise append-only.
uncertainties.resolution: No migration. V20260725180000__core_schema_register_integrity.sql already carries GRANT UPDATE (acknowledged_by, acknowledged_at) for ledger_app, and packages/db/src/schema.ts already declares both columns.

uncertainties.statement: How much of the story's read surface already exists from the alerting delivery that precedes it.
uncertainties.resolution: AC2 is already satisfied by components/alerts/alert-list.tsx via alertSubjectDestination, and AC3 by the scope column the alertas page already renders. Remaining work is the write path and its row action; AC2 and AC3 are covered by regression assertions rather than new behavior.

uncertainties.statement: Concurrency semantics when two admins acknowledge the same alert.
uncertainties.resolution: First writer wins: the update is conditional on acknowledged_at IS NULL, and a second acknowledgment is a no-op that returns the existing acknowledger rather than overwriting attribution.
